LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT (FEES FOR REMOVAL AND DETENTION OF

RELEVANT VEHICLE) REGULATIONS 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 81(3) and paragraph 252(1)(s)

of the Land Public Transport Act 2010 [Act 715], the Minister, on the recommendation

of the Commission, makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport

(Fees for Removal and Detention of Relevant Vehicle) Regulations 2015.

Fees for removal and detention of relevant vehicle

2. The fees payable for removal and detention of a relevant vehicle under

section 81 of the Act shall be as prescribed in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Fees for Removal and Detention of Relevant Vehicles

Item Type of Vehicles Fees

(RM)

Removal Detention

(per day)

1. Motor car 300 150

2. Bus, lorry, tanker, trailer or other type of vehicle which unladen

weight is not exceeding 3500 kilogrammes except motorcycle

and motor car

400 300

3. Bus, lorry, tanker, trailer or other type of vehicle which unladen

weight is exceeding 3500 kilogrammes

500 500
